recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-20419 unless the work group later revisits the search self-link requirement.
issue_request: FHIR-20419 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core search clarification asking that the Bundle self link always be included for every _summary option, including _summary=count, because the self link records the search parameters actually applied by the server.
initial_application: The issue was applied before reconciliation. Jira cites HL7/fhir#1428, and local history contains 86fc08e2a4e8042579c108668812aa9dcc4558f3 and 5cced761f83cd4496a0f56549dae76b52efc4149 titled "Fix FHIR-20419", both adding the requested sentence to source/search.html.
additional_context: The linked Zulip thread records Lloyd McKenzie confirming the self link should be returned for _summary=count or _summary=text. Later FHIR-37753 conformance-language tagging preserved the FHIR-20419 sentence in source/search.html and expressed it as a tagged SHALL. Confluence refs for FHIR-20419 were not found, and Jira searches found no later conflicting FHIR-core decision.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. source/search.html currently says the self link in the search result Bundle is important for interpretation and SHALL always be returned regardless of _summary type.
